has patch diff

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasPatchDiff
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPatchDiff
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

Relates an email message to a patch-diff body part representing the difference between this message and another version (typically between a variant and the canonical body). Non-functional: a message may carry separate header and body patch parts.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:EmailMessage -> gmeow:EmailPatchDiff Sub-property of: gmeow:hasBodyPart

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasPatchDiff from gmeow:EmailMessage to gmeow:EmailPatchDiff when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasBodyPart, gmeow:EmailMessage, gmeow:EmailPatchDiff
